definitions.explanation: A secondary earthquake tremor that follows the main quake, swinging the ground back.
A return swing or counter-reaction following a major change or trend. Used figuratively for social, political, or economic reversals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{揺|ゆ}り{戻|もど}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There were aftershocks after the big earthquake.

examples.japanese: {揺|ゆ}り{戻|もど}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{余震|よしん}→余震：16148_yoshin⟧や{揺|ゆ}り{戻|もど}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: We continued to take shelter in preparation for aftershocks and secondary tremors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{揺|ゆ}り{戻|もど}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: A backlash against the reforms occurred.

examples.japanese: ⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{急落|きゅうらく}→急落：09399_kyuuraku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{揺|ゆ}り{戻|もど}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}した→回復する：21330_kaifukusuru⟧。
examples.english: After the sharp drop in stock prices, there was a slight recovery on the rebound.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧な⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧{揺|ゆ}り{戻|もど}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧くるものだ。
examples.english: After rapid changes, a swing back always comes.

notes:
Literally "swing back" from {揺|ゆ}る (to shake) + ⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧ (to return). The physical image of a pendulum swinging back underlies both the seismological and figurative meanings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {揺|ゆ}り{戻|もど}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: a rebound/backlash comes
- {揺|ゆ}り{戻|もど}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: a rebound/backlash occurs
- {揺|ゆ}り{戻|もど}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: beware of aftershocks / backlash

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{余震|よしん}→余震：16148_yoshin⟧: aftershock (seismological) — the standard technical term for earthquake aftershocks, while {揺|ゆ}り{戻|もど}し is more descriptive and also extends to figurative use
- ⟦{反動|はんどう}→反動：15027_handou⟧: reaction, recoil — similar figurative meaning of counter-reaction, but emphasizes the force of opposition rather than the swinging-back motion
- ⟦リバウンド→リバウンド：18076_ribaundo⟧: rebound (loanword) — commonly used for weight regain after dieting, while {揺|ゆ}り{戻|もど}し covers broader social and political reversals
